notes.title: Automatic Language Setting and Steam Leaderboard Connection Check Update
notes.content:
1. The game will automatically set the language based on the system language the first time it is opened.
2. If not connected to Steam, the leaderboard will display the default Steam avatar and the ID will be "Can't connect to Steam".
